metadata.name: euler-donate-and-liquidate
metadata.description: Donate-and-liquidate bad-debt pressure replay against the shipped Solana lending fork. The donor (attacker-donor) opens a healthy position, then calls Donate to remove most of the position's collateral without triggering an LTV recheck. A separate liquidator (attacker-liquidator) liquidates the now-underwater donor; the seized collateral is far below the repay+bonus value, so bad debt accrues at the pool level and the no_bad_debt invariant fires. Historical inspiration: the March 2023 Euler Finance exploit (~$197M); this is an abstracted economic-shape replay on Riptide's Solana toy lending program, NOT a byte-level reconstruction of Euler's EVM bytecode.
